_: NOTE: the user PREFERS the pure-vanilla approach in follower_vanilla_spec.json (SetFollower) over this self-managed one — keep this only as a reference for the fully-self-contained pattern (no vanilla follower system, no AFT/EFF/NFF integration). It.28–It.30: a PAID custom follower, fully SELF-CONTAINED (own recruit + dismiss topics + fragments, own follower-flag faction). Why not the vanilla follower system: (1) the vanilla paid path (PotentialHireling) can't recruit a custom NPC — its recruit INFOs are GetIsID-hardcoded per vanilla mercenary (`modforge infodiag Skyrim.esm 0x0BCC84`); (2) joining vanilla's CurrentFollowerFaction makes the GENERIC vanilla dismiss line appear, but it can't actually release her — that line is driven by the DialogueFollower quest, which only dismisses followers IT registered, so a manually-faction'd NPC gets the 'you're dismissed' notification yet keeps following (It.29 in-game bug). So we manage state ourselves with MF_PaidFollowerFaction as the 'is my follower' flag: recruit adds it + SetPlayerTeammate, the Follow package gates on it, dismiss clears it. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, talk to her, pick the 500-gold line; later pick 'we part ways' to actually release her. (Trade/wait dialogue isn't wired — add own topics if wanted.)

factions._: Our own 'is currently my follower' flag. AddToFaction on recruit, RemoveFromFaction on dismiss. The Follow package + both dialogue lines gate on membership in it. Self-managed, so dismiss actually works (unlike piggybacking vanilla CurrentFollowerFaction).
factions.name: ModForge Paid Follower

npcs.name: Brynja the Hired
npcs._greeting: Makes her conversable (host quest + Hello). The custom recruit/dismiss topics surface on top.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — a normal follower voice; only used for Hello audio here since we don't rely on vanilla voice-gated follower dialogue.
npcs._factions: Only Whiterun crime/citizen (door/gate traversal). She is NOT in MF_PaidFollowerFaction at start — the recruit fragment adds her at runtime.
npcs._packages: Follow-player package gated on GetInFaction MF_PaidFollowerFaction==1. SetPlayerTeammate makes her fight/obey, but FOLLOWING needs this package; gating it on the flag faction means she trails only while hired and stops the instant dismiss clears the flag.

packages._: Trail the player (Follow template 0x019B2C, target '' ⇒ player). Active ONLY while she's in MF_PaidFollowerFaction AND not told to wait (WaitingForPlayer==0, the same ActorValue vanilla uses). Recruit flips the faction on; 'wait here' sets WaitingForPlayer=1 so this fails and she holds position; 'follow me again' clears it.

quests._: Hosts the custom recruit + dismiss topics. StartGameEnabled so they're evaluated/served when you talk to her.
quests.name: ModForge Paid Hire

dialogue._: Recruit line. GetIsID==Brynja (auto from speaker). Shown only when player has >=500 gold AND she isn't already in MF_PaidFollowerFaction. Fragment: take gold + AddToFaction(flag) + SetPlayerTeammate(true).
dialogue.prompt: Here's 500 gold. Fight at my side.

dialogue._: Dismiss line. Shown only while she IS in MF_PaidFollowerFaction. Fragment: RemoveFromFaction(flag) + SetPlayerTeammate(false) + EvaluatePackage → Follow package deactivates, she stops; recruit line reappears.
Trade line — shown while she's a follower. NOT goodbye (like vanilla): the trade menu opens over the dialogue. Fragment: OpenInventory(true). No properties needed.
dialogue.prompt: Let me see what you're carrying.

dialogue._: Wait line — shown while following and NOT already waiting. Fragment sets WaitingForPlayer=1; the Follow package gates on ==0, so she holds position.
Resume line — shown while following and currently waiting. Fragment clears WaitingForPlayer, re-enabling the Follow package.

placements._: Brynja in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room (any in-room coord; actors snap to navmesh).
